name: Kc Exotic woodworks
old_description: Heirloom quality products as unique as their owners. Building and refinishing services that are backed by quality workmanship.
about:
KC Exotic Woodworks LLC operates from Kansas City, Kansas, providing building and refinishing services backed by quality workmanship. The company offers a broad portfolio of custom woodwork and related crafts.

The workshop produces custom furniture, cabinetry, epoxy resin products, doors, windows, leather goods, and cutting boards. Core processes include woodworking, furniture refinishing, antique restoration, cabinet building and refinishing, epoxy casting for river tables and art, laser engraving, and leather tooling. Materials range from locally harvested hardwoods such as oak, cherry, maple, and walnut to exotic slabs, natural stone, and a full line of epoxy resins for woodworking, casting, and flooring applications.

The company serves residential and commercial clients in the Kansas City area, including homeowners remodeling kitchens, bathrooms, and basements, as well as businesses seeking custom fixtures. They also supply epoxy resins and materials to woodworking hobbyists, resin artists, knife makers, blacksmiths, and flooring professionals. Partnerships with local sawmills and enterprises support material sourcing.

KC Exotic Woodworks differentiates itself through a commitment to craftsmanship and personalized design. The team highlights its strong relationships with local sawmills to secure premium materials, its ability to match custom stains and finishes, and its in-house epoxy resin inventory that supports both production and retail sales. Antique restoration work focuses on preserving historical character while integrating modern functionality.
